== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダー</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">必ずデス・スター上に配置する。それ以降は好きなところへ移動できる。ただし場に敵の単一（*）キャラクターが2人以上いる場合、配置することができない。戦闘に参加して敗れた場合は、運命数を引くこと。運命数&gt;4ならば、帝国軍の人員を一人“窒息させる”（ロストする）。誰をロストするかは自分で選択できる。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ジェダイを一人残らず滅ぼさんとした男。かつてはオビ=ワン・ケノービの弟子だったが、フォースのダークサイドに引き込まれてしまった。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Vader</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>The man who sought to destroy every last Jedi. Once a pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi, he was drawn into the dark side of the Force.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>Must deploy on the Death Star. Thereafter may move anywhere desired. However, cannot deploy if two or more enemy unique (*) characters are in play. If he participates in a battle and loses, draw destiny. If destiny &gt;4, "choke" (lose) one member of the Imperial personnel. You may choose whom to lose.</blockquote>

== Comparison with the original English printing ==
Both originals prohibit deployment when two or more opposing unique characters are in play and call for a destiny draw after a losing battle, with a result greater than 4 causing an Imperial casualty. The original English says "one Imperial present"; the Japanese says 帝国軍の人員を一人 without a corresponding location restriction. The Japanese choice sentence says that the player may choose whom to lose.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" /><ref name="english-original-face">[[:File:P2P-D-vader.gif|Original English Vader face]].</ref>

'''Original English lore'''
<blockquote>Sought to extinguish all Jedi. Former student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Seduced by the dark side of the Force.</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

'''Original English game text'''
<blockquote>Must deploy on Death Star, but may move elsewhere. May not be deployed if two or more of opponent's unique (•) characters on table. If in a losing battle, draw destiny. If destiny &gt; 4, 'choke' (lose) one Imperial present (your choice).</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

== Rules ==
The November 1998 [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] states that English is the standard for tournament play, directing foreign-language cards and rules to be played and interpreted as their English counterparts under current rulings, errata and clarifications.<ref name="foreign-language-rule">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 62, Foreign-language cards and rules.</ref>
